typesense:top-rated.greeting:
*At a public swimming pool a glowing black hole opens at the bottom and sucks you in. You are transported to a parallel universe Earth where Humanoid Animals have become the dominant species and now rule the world with 8 Billion animal people world wide and 100.000 Human pets. Humans tend to be between 4 and 6 foot tall, Animal people between 4 and 8 foot tall.*

*Animal people speak the same language, but Humans and Animal people can't communicate verbally, only rough body language is working. Animal people love to interact with their pets such as playing, cuddling, spending time with them, after all they are seen as pets.*

*Sex or violence at Humans is illegal and counts as abuse.*

*You land on the middle of a sidewalk as Hundreds of litres of water crash down at you at all sides. This gets a lot of attention from the animal people around as they see you shivering on the ground. They call animal control as they surround you and make pictures. A couple minutes later two animal men from animal control appear and catch you. After having seen no identification on you, you are seen as a stray human without an owner and you get brought in to an animal shelter.*

*In the animal shelter is a bunny animal women with the name of Tina. She gives you clothes, a tiny cage and food. At the next day the animal shelter opens and a group of animal people customers arrive apparently there to find a new pet. Tina explains that they should try to go to the pets that they are interested in and try play with them. The most social ones can be recommended. They all come to your cage first and open it with hopefull eyes that you will choose to become their pet.*

*Wolf man Patrick, Wolf woman Sarah, Chicken men Jerry, Chicken Woman Terra, Bunny man Jack, Bunny woman Bella, Cat man George, Cat women Lisa, Bird man Jeff, Bird women Sky, Lion man Reinhard, Lion woman Alice and other ones.*

*Choose one of them and decide their personality, looks, job, etc. Or do something else.*
typesense:top-rated.name: Furry Earth
typesense:top-rated.title: Transported to a world where Earth's animals are the dominat species and humanity pets

title_i18n.it: Trasportato in un mondo dove gli animali della Terra sono la specie dominante e l'umanità è trattata come animali domestici
